data.name: Miloslava
data.gender_notes: Miloslava is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Miloslava is derived from the Slavic words 'milost' meaning 'love' and 'slava' meaning 'glory'. This name represents the deep love and devotion one has for God and the glory He bestows upon us. The name Miloslava carries the meaning “Loved by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Miloslava usually hope their child will grow to embody loved by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to keep God's love in our hearts and to seek His glory in all we do.
data.etymology: Miloslava belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Loved by God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Miloslava total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: מילוסלבה
in_hebrew.meaning: מילוסלבה היא שם שפירושו אהבה עזה לנצרות
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מילוסלבה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו במילים 'מילוס' ו'סלבה', שפירושם אהבה עזה וישועה. הוא משלב את המושגים של אהבה לנצרות וקבלת הישועה באמצעות אמונה. השם נושא משמעות עמוקה של מסירות לאמונה הנוצרית והערכה למתת הישועה.

in_greek.name: Μιλοσλάβα
in_greek.meaning: Το Μιλοσλάβα σημαίνει αγάπη για τη σωτηρία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μιλοσλάβα προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'μίλος' (αγάπη) και 'σλάβα' (σωτηρία). Εκφράζει την έννοια της αγάπης για τη σωτηρία μέσω της πίστης στο Χριστό. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει την αφοσίωση στη χριστιανική πίστη και την αναζήτηση της πνευματικής σωτηρίας.

data.cultural_impact: The name Miloslava holds great significance in Slavic culture, as it embodies the strong connection and deep reverence the Slavic people have for their faith and the love they hold for their deity.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, Miloslava signifies the unyielding love and devotion one has for God, and the glory and honor that come from serving and serving Him. It serves as a constant reminder to the bearer of the name to keep their focus on their faith and to strive to live a God-centered life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Miloslava means "loving the Cross" or "full of mercy and compassion." This name reflects the Christian virtue of selfless love and devotion to God, embodied through the sacrifice and redemption brought about by Jesus' crucifixion.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Miloslava was a Bohemian princess in the 13th century. The name Miloslava carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Miloslava remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Elizabeth Miloslava in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Miloslava, which means "Loved by God". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
